board.webp.prompt: Edit the existing exact straight top-down 8x8 board, changing only the 64 playable square colours: dark squares become clearly lighter mid-tone dusty periwinkle / soft space-blue, roughly mid-grey in luminance, and light squares become pale mist blue. Preserve the exact square geometry and alignment, bottom-right light square, spacecraft-panel border, gold trim, constellation corners, ornaments, crop and hand-painted nebula style; no pieces, text, coordinates, targets, perspective or extra objects.
board.webp.iteration: Controller contrast correction, 2026-10-17. The first board's deep-navy squares caused Dusk navy/violet pieces to disappear. The corrected board uses mean sampled centre luminance about 143/255 for dark squares and 225/255 for light squares; both Dawn and Dusk pieces read on both square colours in the regenerated mock-ups and greyscale blur plate.

picker-card.webp.prompt: Vertical Starlight Alliance picker portrait: Orion, Nova and Astrohoof before a friendly fleet and cozy space station; ornate spacecraft frame and empty lower ribbon; no text, weapons or battle.

story.webp.prompt: Landscape 4:3 warm children's storybook illustration of the Starlight Alliance rescue-pod repair: Nova reconnects shared power, Quasar repairs the bent antenna, Astrohoof brings tools, Pocket Rovers place guide beacons, Orion calmly oversees, and Starbase Seven guards the corridor. Preserve the approved Dawn cast faces, costumes, helmet and crown shapes, motifs and cloud-white/cyan/coral/gold colours while showing living characters without chess pedestals; gentle top-left golden light and cool rim; one clear cooperative moment; friendly faces and sound hands; no text, weapons, battle or frightening imagery.
story.webp.reference: The six approved Dawn piece masters were consolidated into one identity sheet and supplied as the generation reference.

look_r3.prompt: Intergalactic Space boxed-chess set: Orion king, Nova queen, Quasar bishop, Astrohoof robot-horse knight, Starbase Seven rook and Pocket Rover pawn in exact 3x2 Dawn and Dusk sheets; six orbital cameos; ivory/cobalt/navy orbital starbase frame; no text.
look_r3.review: PASS attempt 1 for pieces, portraits and frame: six distinct silhouettes per side remain clear at 70px; no text; Orion, Nova and Quasar have fully concealed hands and no visible fingers.
look_r3.processing: build-look-r3.py removes disconnected sheet bleed, fits quality-86 192px pieces to the pilot ladder, exports quality-78 320px portraits, a quality-68 640px frame and the tracked quality-70 WebP contact sheet.

look_r6_space_sides.prompt: Reference-edit each approved Intergalactic Space Dusk figurine by changing colour only: dominant deep navy and midnight teal costume, body and pedestal; cool silver and pearl in place of gold, brass and cream trim; a darker navy-teal shell/base; restrained cobalt, cyan, violet and magenta gem highlights; and platinum silver-white or cool blue-silver hair/mane where useful. Preserve exact character identity, face, expression, skin tone, hairstyle/mane shape, pose, anatomy, chess-role silhouette, accessories, crown/helmet geometry, crop, camera, scale, full pedestal and concealed hands; no text, props, shadow or extra objects.
look_r6_space_sides.processing: Accepted 1254×1254 RGBA built-in outputs were alpha-cropped, proportionally fitted into each previous 192×192 runtime piece's occupied box, bottom-centred, and exported as quality-86 RGBA WebP. Dawn and all shared portraits stayed byte-for-byte unchanged. Portraits are Dawn-neutral handbook identities rather than side-specific Dusk variants, so no portrait recolour was appropriate.
look_r6_space_sides.review: PASS attempt 1. Every Dusk role reads immediately as the dark team at 90 px on both cream #FFF3D9 and lilac #B9A2D4, with midnight navy/teal masses, silver trim and silver-white/cool hair or mane. At 300%, the king, queen and bishop retain concealed hands; the knight, rook and pawn have no human hands.
